_comment: C-first v19 candidate frozen before recording and JavaScript comparison. Tourist initialization sets starting money with rnd(1000) in u_init.c:PM_TOURIST (756), so the hero enters with carried gold without a wished-money setup. The initial newline dismisses the welcome pager; Control-G opens wizgenesis in debug mode and requests a hostile leprechaun. With safe_wait disabled, six periods are intended as elapsed turns. Observe the actual creation position, carried purse and mhitu.c:mattacku -> mhitu.c:hitmu -> uhitm.c:mhitm_adtyping(AD_SGLD) -> uhitm.c:mhitm_ad_sgld -> steal.c:stealgold path; retain a valid target miss or matching result as recorded.
